title: Feed consumer crash (with GS.19b crash after outbox delivery)
source: lab/TARGETS.md section 6 row 19, section 6.1 (GS.19b), section 1.1 P3 items 4 to 6; RULINGS Q38f
story: The dependency-index consumer crashes mid-stream and resumes from its checkpoint. Added schedule GS.19b: the consumer crashes after delivering an outbox item but before recording completion. Q38f cases: a crash before delivery, and an unchanged activation (same payload) during recovery.
checked: No gap, no duplicate processing, per-subject order kept; catch-up lag measured. Crash points: A before the effect, D after the durable outbox write but before delivery (Q38f), B after delivery before completion is recorded (GS.19b), C after the checkpoint. Deliveries are keyed (id, publication sequence); the set delivered equals the set implied by the committed stream (a new sequence only when the payload changes); the receiver shows exactly one visible effect per key while replays happen; the unchanged activation publishes nothing.

witnesses.positive: subjects with E-Verify signals in the live phase (delivered to the receiver)
witnesses.negative: idle onboarded subjects (never in a live-phase transaction, so never delivered)

domain: the dependency-index affected-subject set including subjects reached through referenced entities (O-DOMAIN)
work-item payloads and their publication sequences under W0 (O-DOMAIN); the harness payload is the asserted (attribute, value) set per subject
faults: crash after the outbox write, before delivery (D, Q38f)
crash after delivery, before completion is recorded (B, GS.19b)

oracle.source: O-REPLAY (directly written subjects per transaction, receipts); O-DOMAIN (referenced-entity dependencies)
gaps: the outbox is the Triplex journal itself; an atomic outbox table in the source transaction (TARGETS section 3) is not in the triplex-public composition

rungNote: Sized for a shared 2-CPU dev slot (measured 2026-11-07: about 0.1 to 1 commits/s under pinned readers): the rung is the 10k-subject background world; the live phase runs the fixed trace (15 facts/s, open loop) for 25 s with a scaled scenario overlay. Year-one volumes wait for PLAN section 8 order 6.
deliveryIdentity: RULINGS Q38f (main baeb9fd): work-item delivery identity is (id, publication sequence); the sequence increments whenever the payload to publish differs from the latest published payload for that id; publication state is persisted atomically with the outbox record; unacknowledged deliveries survive crashes and replay with their original identity; duplicate-visible-effect checks count by (id, publication sequence).
